doc.title: Allan Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000

title: Sol Yaged
summary: He knows Sol Yaged, a Benny Goodman devotee.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Did you ever have occasion to associate with Sol Yaged by any chance?
Oh I know Sol very well, yeah. Very interesting guy.
We saw him a couple of months ago, I was just curious if you knew him.

Yeah I know Sol. Sol’s a nice guy. He’s a good player, and he’s a little bit odd but he’s still a very nice guy. And I’ve always thought he was a great player. He’s really got all that Benny stuff down. I mean he’s a real heavy student of Benny, to the point of Benny’s actions, like dropping the right shoulder and this kind of thing. Sol’s got it all down.
